info.title: API.SH: UFC
info.description: The UFC API from API.SH: public UFC data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A fighter's profile: division, record, tags (rank, title holder, status), bio (age, height, weight, reach, leg reach, place of birth, team, style, Octagon debut), highlights (win streak, wins by KO/submission, first-round finishes), career stats (significant strikes landed/attempted, per minute, absorbed, defense, takedowns and accuracy, submission average, knockdown average, average fight time), significant strikes by position and target, win methods and latest fights (opponent, result, round, time, method, event and fight id). The fight history comes 3 fights a page, newest first: pass `fights_next_page` back as `fights_page` for older fights (null on the last page).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ufc-athlete

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Athlete slug from ufc.com, events or rankings (e.g. islam-makhachev, alex-pereira).

parameters.name: fights_page
parameters.description: Page of the fight history, 1-30 (3 fights a page; default 1). Pass `fights_next_page` here.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every athlete on ufc.com, A to Z, or those matching a name: name, nickname, division, record (wins, losses, draws), social links, photo, slug and profile link (use the slug with /ufc/v1/athlete). About 11 per page; `total` is the number of athletes. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ufc-athletes

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Name to search for; omit for the full A-Z roster.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: UFC event fight card and results
get.description:
An event's full fight card in order: card segment and broadcaster, weight class and limit, title fight and belts, scheduled rounds, referee, result (method, round, time, ending strike, target and position, submission, judges' scores, fight of the night) and both fighters (record, nickname, born, fighting out of, age, stance, height, reach, weigh-in, outcome, bonuses, profile link), plus venue and status (live round when the event is on).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ufc-event

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Event slug from `/ufc/v1/events` or the ufc.com URL (e.g. ufc-300).

parameters.name: event_id
parameters.description: Or the numeric event id returned by this route.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Upcoming or past UFC events: slug (use it with `/ufc/v1/event`), headline, main card, prelims and early prelims start times, venue, city, region and country, with the total count. Pass `next_page` back as `page` for older events; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ufc-events

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page of past events (8 per page).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Official stats of one fight: the fight and result as in `/ufc/v1/event`, and for each fighter totals and round-by-round knockdowns, total and significant strikes (attempted/landed by head, body, leg, distance, clinch, ground), accuracy, takedowns, submission attempts, reversals and control time.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ufc-fight

parameters.name: fight_id
parameters.description: Fight id from `/ufc/v1/event` (11234 = Pereira v Hill, UFC 300).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Career records (default), single-fight, single-round or event records, or combined fight and round records.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
